name: Risely Digital
subject: 🔴 Risely Digital — your website scored 30/100 (here's why)
html:
Hi Risely Digital,

I ran a free automated audit on https://riselydigital.com and wanted to share the results with you.

30/100
Grade: F

Here's what I found:

  • ❌ 🔍 SEO: Title Tag — Missing or too short
  • ❌ 🔍 SEO: Meta Description — Missing or too short
  • ❌ 🔒 Security: HSTS — Strict-Transport-Security not set
  • ❌ 🔒 Security: MIME Type Protection — X-Content-Type-Options not set
  • ⚠️ 🔒 Security: Server Info — Server exposed: Apache
  • ❌ ⚡ Performance: Compression — No compression detected
  • ❌ ⚡ Performance: Browser Caching — No cache headers
  • ⚠️ ⚡ Performance: Resource Hints — No preconnect/preload hints

Here's what I'd prioritize:

  1. Fix: Missing or too short
  2. Fix: Missing or too short
  3. Fix: Strict-Transport-Security not set
  4. Fix: X-Content-Type-Options not set
  5. Fix: No compression detected
